verdict.rationale: Clara documents a dedicated sandbox environment for end-to-end integration testing "without affecting real data or triggering real financial operations" (clara-docs-8). It also provides sandbox-specific tooling, such as an on-demand test webhook events endpoint under `/api-test/` (clara-docs-9). Missing for 10: details on sandbox credentials, base URL separation and seeded test data, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox works as described.
